test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment in which the article has been used INCORRECTLY.

UNESCO works to / strengthen an intellectual / and moral solidarity / of humankind.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the article "**an**" before "**intellectual**."
 
• The correct article to use before "**intellectual**" is "**the**" because it refers to a specific type of solidarity.
 
• The phrase should be "**strengthen the intellectual**" to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"UNESCO works to strengthen the intellectual and moral solidarity of humankind."*
